text: Edits went too far: on 6 September the author had the original Hallucination essay and the original Arabic parking and politics essay restored as the editing baseline. The voice is the asset; edits are proposals.

An unsupported "8x billing" claim was withdrawn and the Nobel framing, complexity claims and the definitions of the price of anarchy and Nash equilibrium corrected in one pass: claims need a checker who did not write them.
Demos are built test-first and judged by someone who did not build them (the edu-demo skills; docs/decision-lab-pedagogy.md).
ubuntu-latest moved to 26.04, where Playwright 1.57 cannot install Chromium; CI failed before any test ran. Pin the runner (ubuntu-24.04) and upgrade Playwright on purpose.
One warm editor per post, then the independent fact-check, instead of two cold editors in a row (PRINCIPLES.md P2; Benchmark 6: a relay cost 2.3x with no accuracy gain). To be judged on M1.
